adversarial_max_attacks.description: cap on generated attack probes per run — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml review.adversarial.max_attacks

adversarial_min_tier.description: adversarial pass trigger tier (low|medium|high|critical) or "off"; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml review.adversarial.min_tier (issue #180)

diff_max_bytes.description: byte cap on the diff embedded in the review prompt

external_reviewer.description: external reviewer slug prefix (e.g. coderabbit) — override; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml review.external_reviewer (unset there = AI-only path)

findings_max.description: findings kept in the verdict record and the fix prompt

ledger_head.description: upstream run-ledger chain head — seeds this stage entry prev; empty = recover the ai-sdlc:ledger-head marker on the PR (issue #196)

max_fix_iterations.description: fix pushes per PR before needs-human — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml review.max_fix_iterations

max_seconds.description: engine wall-clock budget per run — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml engine.max_seconds

max_steps.description: engine tool-step budget per run — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml engine.max_steps

model.description: reviewer model override; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml review.ai_reviewer.model → model.primary

pipeline_author.description: PR author login treated as pipeline-managed (the ai-sdlc App bot identity)

pipeline_label.description: label that also marks a PR as pipeline-managed (human-branch opt-in)

provider_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible inference base URL; empty → vars.AI_SDLC_PROVIDER_URL → GitHub Models default

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch runtime scripts/actions from

adversarial.description: adversarial pass summary: ran:<verdict>:<n>-attacks | skip:<verdict>:<n>-attacks | not-configured

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head for this review run (issue #196)

risk_tier.description: deterministic diff tier: low | medium | high | critical (empty when skipped)

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints the per-run installation token used for all git/gh auth (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)

MODEL_API_KEY.description: optional direct provider key; absent → GitHub Models via GITHUB_TOKEN
